items.name: Sreebhumi Sporting Club (Lake Town)
items.notes: Theme: Grand Vatican & Venetian Architectural Replica with Chandannagar Gold Lights. Nearest Metro: Belgachia / Ultadanga Station.

details.name: Sreebhumi Sporting Club (Lake Town)
details.bestTime: 01:00 AM - 04:30 AM (Midnight to avoid peak rush)
details.theme: Grand Vatican & Venetian Architectural Replica with Chandannagar Gold Lights
details.artisan: Romeo Hazra (Concept & Architecture) & Pradip Rudra Pal (Idol Sculptor)
details.description: The undisputed epicenter of colossal architectural grandeur in North Kolkata, renowned for breathtaking monument replicas and royal gold illumination.
details.history: Founded in 1969 in Lake Town, Sreebhumi Sporting Club has evolved into Kolkata's premier architectural spectacle, famous for its magnificent scale, grand palace replicas, and exquisite gold jewelry ornaments.

items.name: Kumartuli Park
items.notes: Theme: Sculptural Fusion of Clay, Myth, and Modern Illumination. Nearest Metro: Sovabazar Sutanuti.

details.name: Kumartuli Park
details.theme: Sculptural Fusion of Clay, Myth, and Modern Illumination
details.description: Nestled in the birthplace of Kolkata’s clay artisans, presenting visionary conceptual installations fused with pure traditional idol artistry.
details.history: Located at the heart of Bengal's legendary idol-making district Kumartuli, this puja was established in 1995 to showcase the pinnacle of avant-garde Bengali sculpting and innovative clay architecture.

items.name: Arsalan - Flagship (Park Circus 7-Point Crossing)
items.notes: Food Stop: Must-try Mutton Special Biryani (2 Mutton + 1 Egg + Aloo), Mutton Chaap (₹750 for two).

details.name: Arsalan - Flagship
details.description: The gold standard of Kolkata Biryani. Long-grain basmati with saffron, slow-braised mutton, and silky potato.
mustTry: Mutton Special Biryani (2 Mutton + 1 Egg + Aloo)

items.name: Peter Cat (Park Street Flagship)
items.notes: Food Stop: Must-try Special Chelo Kebab (Mutton & Chicken), Mixed Grill Sizzler (₹1200 for two).

details.name: Peter Cat
details.description: Park Street's crown jewel. Amber lighting, turbaned servers, and Chelo Kebab with melting egg yolk.

items.name: Tala Prattoy
items.notes: Theme: Monumental Concept Art & Immersive Spatial Architecture. Nearest Metro: Belgachia / Shyambazar.

details.name: Tala Prattoy
details.theme: Monumental Concept Art & Immersive Spatial Architecture
details.description: Globally recognized for boundary-pushing contemporary fine art installations that transform spatial design into transcendent philosophical experiences.
details.history: Founded in 1968, Tala Prattoy is internationally acclaimed for museum-quality conceptual art installations, frequently collaborating with renowned contemporary visual artists.

items.name: Dum Dum Park Tarun Sangha
items.notes: Theme: Surrealist Folk Textures & Futuristic Chromatic Lighting. Nearest Metro: Dum Dum / Belgachia.

details.name: Dum Dum Park Tarun Sangha
details.theme: Surrealist Folk Textures & Futuristic Chromatic Lighting
details.description: A perennial powerhouse of thematic brilliance in the Dum Dum Park circuit with jaw-dropping textures and ambient soundscapes.
details.history: Established in 1972, Tarun Sangha is a powerhouse along VIP Road known for introducing groundbreaking contemporary conceptual themes crafted from organic and indigenous materials.

items.name: Dum Dum Park Tarun Dal
items.notes: Theme: Harmonic Geometry & Handcrafted Tribal Sculptures. Nearest Metro: Dum Dum.

details.name: Dum Dum Park Tarun Dal
details.description: Masterfully crafted geometric structures blending traditional terracotta, brass bells, and hypnotic folk motifs.
details.history: Founded in 1978, Dum Dum Park Tarun Dal is celebrated for grand structural pandals with mesmerizing lighting tunnels and detailed idol craftsmanship.
